summary: Read-only review (git reads in blobless clone, gh read-only queries; no code or tests executed by the reviewer). Diff vs controller base b062de33: 5 new source files plus an evidence packet under artifacts/task-validation/maintenance-470/protected-main-readonly-packet-8. demo-storage-inspect.mjs vs approved 92931e60: (1) helper imports switch from demo-storage-backups.mjs/demo-patient-inventory.mjs to the new pure module demo-storage-binding-readonly.mjs; (2) BRANCH moves to main, and validateContext now also requires GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF, GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA==GITHUB_SHA, actor l2v-hub == triggering actor, DEMO_STORAGE_ENVIRONMENT and an explicit auth mode, with the inactive credential required to be empty and tokens bounded (no CR/LF, at most 8192 chars); (3) a new account-bearer mode adds two fixed GraphQL reads (query{me{id}} with the identity discarded; project/environment canAccess with exact variables) gated by accountStage/step, sends an Authorization Bearer header instead of Project-Access-Token, and hands the CLI child RAILWAY_API_TOKEN only; (4) receipt adds authMode/workflowRef/protectedEnvironment/credentialKind/projectTokenVerified/targetReadAccess, and the secret scrub now includes RAILWAY_API_TOKEN; (5) BACKEND_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED is added to the constant helper codes. The exact argv allowlist, query set (no mutations), double binding read, classifier after UNCLASSIFIED_DEMO_VOLUMES, two snapshot lists, constant codes and the no-cleanup receipt are unchanged. demo-storage-binding-readonly.mjs: inspectStorageBinding and verifyDatabaseMount are byte-identical to the 92931e60 demo-storage-backups.mjs versions, and verifyDemoBinding/verifyDatabaseUrl/TARGET are identical to demo-patient-inventory.mjs. The only change is one additional check (backend source.repo == l2v-hub/ClinicOS -> BACKEND_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED), so it is at least as strict. Its only imports are node:path and node:crypto. It has no spawn, fetch, fs, env, SQL, erase, delete, redeploy or variable writes, and its GraphQL strings are two read queries that already match QUERIES.domain/environment in the transport allowlist. Workflow: workflow_dispatch plus pull_request (paths-limited, test job only, no secrets). The inspect job is gated on event, repo, ref main, workflow_ref, actor, triggering_actor, workflow_sha == sha, reviewed_sha == sha and the auth_mode enum. Permissions are contents: read. Actions are pinned by SHA with persist-credentials false. Tests run in a credential-free job before the inspect job (needs: test). Concurrency group demo-storage-inspect (not railway-backend), cancel-in-progress false. Timeouts are 5/10/1 min. The secret is referenced only in the inspect step env. The artifact holds only the stdout receipt (stderr excluded, 7-day retention), and the receipt carries only ids/counts/booleans/constant codes. Verified via gh API: Environment 'glistening-friendship / demo' has a branch policy limited to main, and RAILWAY_DEMO_TOKEN is environment-scoped; the repo-level RAILWAY_TOKEN is not referenced. CI at the subject SHA: test pass (26s), inspect skipping (expected, dispatch-only), secret-scan, gate, frontend/browser/archive tests pass. The packet claims 152 focused tests and 29 synthetic probes PASS; it is synthetic only, and no live provider observation has been made (stated in the packet). Blocking issue: the Railway CLI that receives the demo credential is installed by npm version pin only, with no checksum, although a checksum-verified install precedent exists in protect-demo-secret.yml. Also, the account-bearer CLI path issues an environment-unscoped variables read.

findings.problem: The Railway CLI is installed with `npm install -g @railway/cli@5.66.0`, pinned only by npm version: there is no artifact checksum, lifecycle scripts run, and a binary is downloaded at install time. The next step runs this unverified `railway` executable, resolved via PATH, with RAILWAY_DEMO_TOKEN in its environment (the token may be an account-wide bearer token in account-bearer mode). The required 'pinned Railway CLI install with checksum before secrets' is not met, although main already has a checksum-verified install pattern (protect-demo-secret.yml lines 35-49 for gh).
findings.requested_change: Download a fixed Railway CLI release archive for linux x86_64 by exact URL, verify it with a hard-coded sha256 (sha256sum --check --status) before extraction, check --version against 5.66.0, and expose the verified absolute path (for example via GITHUB_ENV, or a fixed path that demo-storage-inspect.mjs spawns instead of a bare 'railway' PATH lookup). Do this in a step with no secrets, before the inspect step. Alternatively, use npm with --ignore-scripts plus a verified tarball integrity, but the binary itself must still be checksum-verified.
findings.test_expectation: demo-storage-workflow.test.mjs asserts that the install step contains the fixed release URL, a 64-hex sha256 literal, sha256sum --check, and a version check; that no 'npm install -g @railway/cli' remains; that the verification step precedes the first 'secrets.' reference; and that the spawned CLI path is the verified one.

findings.problem: The BACKEND_IDENTITY argv `variables --service <backend> --json` has no --environment and no --project. With a project token, the token pins the demo environment. In the new account-bearer mode, RAILWAY_API_TOKEN is account-wide and the CI checkout has no railway link. The CLI will therefore either fail (making account-bearer mode non-functional, though it fails closed with READONLY_CLI_FAILED) or resolve some non-demo environment of the shared project and load that environment's variables, possibly production DATABASE_URL, into process memory before the identity check rejects them. Tests mock spawn, so neither behaviour is exercised.
findings.requested_change: Make the account-bearer mode explicitly scope every CLI read to the demo target. For example, allow BACKEND_IDENTITY only as `variables --service <backend> --environment <demo env> --json` when authMode is account-bearer, and pass the project explicitly or via a fixed, validated non-secret link mechanism. Otherwise, remove account-bearer mode until a live observation shows it works, keeping project-token only (least privilege, since an account token is broader than the demo environment).
findings.test_expectation: A test with ACCOUNT_ENV asserts that every spawned argv includes --environment <TARGET.environmentId> (and the project scoping, if added), and that the unscoped `variables --service <backend> --json` argv is rejected with READONLY_COMMAND_REJECTED in account-bearer mode, while project-token behaviour is unchanged.

findings.problem: The supposedly pure read-only extraction carries over the unused SAFE_REPLACEMENT_ERRORS set, which contains replacement/redeploy-era codes (REDEPLOY_UNVERIFIED, DEPLOYMENT_SOURCE_CONFIG_CHANGED, REPLACEMENT_NOT_CONVERGED, ...). This is dead code that implies mutation capability in a module whose contract is 'no cleanup entrypoints'. The line-1 comment also has a typo ('maintenance92931e60').
findings.requested_change: Delete SAFE_REPLACEMENT_ERRORS (it is never referenced) and fix the header comment so the module contains only the extracted read-only checks.
findings.test_expectation: demo-storage-workflow.test.mjs forbidden-token list adds 'SAFE_REPLACEMENT_ERRORS', 'REDEPLOY', and 'REPLACEMENT' for demo-storage-binding-readonly.mjs; all existing focused tests still pass.
